ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Daycare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of the daycare fraud scandal in Minnesota, including how scammers were able to leave the US with large amounts of cash.
questions: How were scammers able to leave the US with up to $1M in cash?
What financial institutions were used to facilitate the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story would require a deep dive into financial records and transactions to uncover the extent of the fraud and identify potential accomplices.
